adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute, poll_feed is gated by three conditions: feed_polling_enabled?, feed_polling_url.present?, and embed_by_username.present? (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb lines 13-15). In the specs "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username", only feed_polling_url/embed_by_username are stubbed to nil, but feed_polling_enabled? is not stubbed to true (spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb). Since the default setting in site_settings.yml is false for feed_polling_enabled, execute can skip poll_feed due to the first condition, making these tests pass even if the url/username guards were removed. This is a real, diff-grounded test-coverage issue, not a production behavior bug.
